name: vazue-queue
description: OSS-first virtual waiting room on AWS

scripts.test:unit: cargo test --workspace --manifest-path packages/core-rust/Cargo.toml && pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* run test --if-present
scripts.test:integration: cargo test --workspace --manifest-path packages/core-rust/Cargo.toml --test '*' -- --ignored 2>/dev/null || cargo test --workspace --manifest-path packages/core-rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/core-rust/Cargo.toml && pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* run fmt --if-present
